'''Bothawui Jewellers''' was a jewelry business that operated on the floating [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="TJoY" /> at some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Timeframe">The events of ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' took place while [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a period which started in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] and ended in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> The business was run by a [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] couple, [[Henna]] and [[Cidri]],<ref name="TJoY" /> and named for the Bothan [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The two jewellers ran their operation out of a weathered [[JumpMaster 5000/Legends|JumpMaster 5000]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which they set up on [[Market Row]], a commercial corridor located within the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of Cloud City.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bothawui Jewellers first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The jewellers is listed as a vendor that players can purchase goods from, but no specific interactions are listed.<ref name="TJoY" />
